class_names_note: Snapshot of the current released class set (kept in sync from the dataset YAML via scripts/write_export_contract.py). It is NOT the frozen source of truth for class count — each model's model-metadata.json is. Class count can grow release to release without editing this contract.

output_shape_rule.num_classes_source: model-metadata.json class_names length (NOT a frozen literal)
output_shape_rule.anchors_note: sum of P3/P4/P5 grid cells for input_size 640 (80^2 + 40^2 + 20^2)

output_layout_note: Raw one-to-many YOLO26-seg head. Detection feature dim = 4 (box) + num_classes + 32 (mask coefficients), over 8400 anchors. num_classes is class-count-dependent and is NOT frozen here: the app MUST read it from class_names.length in each model's model-metadata.json and compute mask-coefficient offset = 4 + num_classes, never a hardcoded value. Concrete examples: 2 classes -> [1, 38, 8400], 5 -> [1, 41, 8400], 10 -> [1, 46, 8400]. onnx2tf/litert may transpose tensors at runtime ([1, F, 8400] <-> [1, 8400, F]; protos [1,32,160,160] <-> [1,160,160,32]); the app detects orientation. NMS + mask assembly run on-device.
